task: You are now playing a fast paced game of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, attempt to head west. After that, pick-up the type 4 key from the floor of the bedchamber. Then, make an attempt to go south. And then, lift the key from the floor of the studio. And if you do that, you're the winner!
